url.description: Base URL of the running dev server (e.g., http://localhost:3000).

waitFor.description: Playwright wait condition used after page.goto(). One of: networkidle, load, domcontentloaded.

fileKey.description: Figma file key — the path segment after /file/ in your Figma file URL.

changelogPageName.description: Name of the Figma page where per-round changelog entries will be written.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the Figma frame title (e.g., 'Login', 'Dashboard').

path.description: Path appended to devServer.url for this route. Must start with /.

waitFor.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before capturing this route. Used as page.waitForSelector(<this string>). For wait conditions, use devServer.waitFor.

git.description: Optional git workflow integration. Omit entirely to disable git suggestions.

branchPerRound.description: How the implement gate should handle branching. 'ask' prompts each round, 'always' auto-creates figloops/round-N-<date>, 'never' skips git entirely.
